text:
My husband is in the visa process. We are waiting on a document to resubmit the application for his B1, but until it's submitted they won't grant him a tourist visa extension. I want to know what plan B is in case they still do not grant him an extension after we submit the application for his B1. If he has to leave that's fine, but I want to know that he can come back, how soon, and if he needs to apply again for a new tourist visa. 

I have zero faith in Israeli bureaucracy with what we've been through, so I need to plan for every possible outcome.
